messages.summary:
## Objective
- Update the existing FIELDWORK game to detect mobile devices, require landscape play, and fit phone screens; make the PC version compatible with 120 FPS.

## Requirements
- Build on the existing playable game; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot, if screenshots are taken.

## Decisions
- Detect mobile via user-agent plus touch/coarse-pointer and screen-size checks.
- Show a rotate-phone gate in portrait and attempt to lock orientation to landscape when deploying.
- Use mobile-aware viewport resizing and a lower mobile pixel-ratio cap.
- Run the simulation at a fixed 120 Hz while rendering at the display’s native `requestAnimationFrame` cadence.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added mobile detection, landscape gating, orientation-lock attempt, and dynamic viewport resizing in `game.js`.
- Added the orientation prompt in `index.html` and landscape/mobile responsive rules in `style.css`.
- Changed the animation loop to a fixed 120 Hz simulation timestep with native display-rate rendering.
- `node --check game.js` passed; `git diff --check` passed after removing an extra blank line.

### Active
- Validate the mobile landscape and desktop 120 FPS changes in-browser; no screenshot or runtime test has been performed.

### Blocked

## Objective
- Update the existing FIELDWORK game to detect mobile devices, require landscape play, and fit phone screens; make the PC version compatible with 120 FPS.

## Requirements
- Build on the existing playable game; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot, if screenshots are taken.

## Decisions
- Detect mobile using user-agent plus touch/coarse-pointer and screen-size checks.
- Show a rotate-phone gate in portrait and attempt to lock orientation to landscape when gameplay starts.
- Use mobile-aware viewport resizing and a lower mobile pixel-ratio cap.
- Run simulation at a fixed 120 Hz while rendering at native `requestAnimationFrame` cadence.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added mobile detection, landscape gating, an orientation-lock attempt, and dynamic viewport resizing in `game.js`.
- Added the orientation prompt in `index.html` and landscape/mobile responsive rules in `style.css`.
- Changed the animation loop to fixed 120 Hz simulation updates with native display-rate rendering.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed after follow-up fixes.

### Active
- Validate desktop and mobile layouts/gameplay in-browser; no screenshot or runtime test has been performed.
- Review/fix any validation issues, including mobile touch gameplay and viewport fit.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run browser checks for desktop and mobile portrait/landscape behavior; save and inspect only the latest small JPEG screenshot if doing visual checks.
2. Fix any issues, then report changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: device detection, orientation handling, resizing, touch controls, and simulation/render loop.
- `index.html`: orientation gate markup and game UI.
- `style.css`: mobile and landscape responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted in `game.js`, `index.html`, and `style.css`.
- `game.js` imports Three.js from jsDelivr.
